scripts.build: rm -rf build/ && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p build/proto/auth build/proto/money_movement && cp proto/auth/auth.proto build/proto/auth/auth.proto && cp proto/money_movement/money_movement.proto build/proto/money_movement/money_movement.proto
scripts.proto:copy: mkdir -p proto/auth proto/money_movement && cp -r ../auth/proto/* proto/auth && cp -r ../money_movement/proto/* proto/money_movement
